protocol.name: SHoEbox MAD-style capability protocol v1
protocol.claim: SHoEbox byte adaptation; not the original MAD score
protocol.selection: lowest mean final development task NLL across paired seeds; test only the selected hyperparameters
protocol.training_objective: masked answer-token loss plus existing native auxiliary objectives; compression uses a separately trained single-vector MLP readout
protocol.alignment: each answer delimiter completes a real 64-byte L3 constituent; all padding is observed and charged to the input-byte budget
protocol.difficulty_selection: control development accuracy only; explicit uncalibrated status when no setting is in the target band
protocol.timing: serial pinned CPU; compilation, dataset generation, evaluation and checkpoint I/O excluded from training; episode reset and final retirement included
protocol.promotion: three paired seeds, calibrated held-out capability gain, matched-byte and matched-time evidence, frozen contribution checks, and a separate matched natural-language guardrail

calibration.reason: No control development score is in the difficulty band.

summary.promotion: not assessed; requires calibrated multi-seed evidence and a separate natural-language guardrail
